product_metadata.title: Carnation Home Fashions Jumbo Long Vinyl Shower Curtain Liner, 72-Inch by 96-Inch, Bone
features: Wipes Clean With A Damp Sponge
description: "Jumbo" Long shower curtain, specially-sized (72'' wide x 96'' long) for those hard to fit shower areas. This Shower Curtain Liner, made of an extra heavy (8 gauge) vinyl, easily wipes clean. Additionally, rust-proof metal grommets along the top of the liner prevent unsightly rips and tears. With this liner, you wouldn't even need a shower curtain. Here in Bone, you can find this Jumbo Long Vinyl Liner in white and super clear.
